subject: Horizon Labs evaluation: latency & throughput test plan and follow-ups
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Qureshi <samira@horizon.ai>, Tariq Ahmed <tariq@horizon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2029 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: latency & throughput plan from today's discovery

Hi Samira / Tariq —

Thanks for a productive call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the competitive evaluation you asked for:

Recap:
- Goal: quantify latency and tokens/sec differences between Redwood inference and the hyperscaler endpoint you flagged (StratusAI), across your short-chat and batch summarization workloads.
- Success metrics you shared: p95 latency for short chat <= 150ms, p99 < 350ms; steady-state throughput 4k-8k tokens/sec for the summarization pipeline.
- Constraints: runs must be reproducible in your environment; you prefer Redwood to run Hosted evaluation first, then Dedicated/VPC if results look promising.

Proposed test matrix (attached spreadsheet + short version below):
- Test A (light): 1 convo / 1–3 turns, seq len 64 tokens, request rate 50 qps for 5 minutes — measure p50/p95/p99 and error rate.
- Test B (heavy): batch summarization, seq len 512 input / 128 output, parallel clients to target 5k tokens/sec sustained for 10 minutes.
- Test C (scale): burst traffic with 95th-percentile client concurrency (simulate spikes) to validate graceful degradation and fallback behavior.

Comparison axes: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec (measured server-side), cost per 1M tokens, error/timeout rate, and reproducibility (variance).

Immediate asks from Horizon:
1) Can you confirm a test window next Tue morning PT (22nd) for an initial Hosted A/B sweep?
2) Point us to a stable sample dataset (or allow us to run synthetic sequences with your length distribution).
3) Any specific security/egress constraints for us connecting to StratusAI endpoints for cross-measurement?

Internal note: Marissa / Jordan — see the attached runbook. Marissa, can you pre-provision the Redwood hosted sandbox with the gpt-redwood-3b-quant model and the StratusAI competitor endpoint we discussed? Add a canary route for fallback verification. Jordan — please scope the load generator profile (k6 + custom token encoder) and the exporter tags we will need to align with Horizon telemetry.

Samira / Tariq — thanks again. If the proposed windows work, I'll schedule the lab run and share the spreadsheet with the measurement checklist.

Cheers,
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0179

Attachment: horizon-test-matrix-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet; test matrix & sequences)

From: Samira Qureshi <samira@horizon.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tariq Ahmed <tariq@horizon.ai>, Procurement Horizon <procure@horizon.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Jun 2029 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: latency & throughput plan from today's discovery

Thanks Rishi — this is exactly the level of detail we needed. Tos and team reviewed the matrix; a couple quick clarifications: 

- The p95/p99 targets on our side are aspirational for the short-chat (we're evaluating productized user impact). If Redwood can demonstrate a clear tail-latency advantage vs StratusAI for seq len <= 128 that will move us forward.
- We can provide a sanitized sample dataset (20k chat snippets + 5k docs for summarization) by Monday EOD. We'll share a Drive link once sanitized.

Test window: Tue 22nd morning PT works for initial sweep. Please limit the first run to Hosted comparisons only — our security team wants to observe network/egress behavior before authorizing any VPC tests.

Also, two procurement asks (looping in procurement):
- Do you have an MSA template we can review ahead of Dedicated discussions?
- Any standard SOC2 artifacts you typically provide for initial risk review?

We'll expect the Redwood runbook and access instructions by EOD tomorrow.

Samira
VP of ML Ops, Horizon Labs

On security: Tariq — we want to capture traceroute and outbound IPs during the Hosted run. Is that ok?

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Qureshi <samira@horizon.ai>, Tariq Ahmed <tariq@horizon.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2029 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: latency & throughput plan from today's discovery

Great — thanks for the quick turnaround, Samira. A few bullets in reply: 

- Hosted sweep only on Tue 22nd confirmed. We'll run three back-to-back A/B sweeps: short-chat (seq<=128), long context summarization (seq 512->128), and burst stress. We'll capture p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec (server measured), and per-route cost estimate.
- We'll publish the runbook (redwood-mini-runbook.pdf) and a short script for traceroute/IP collection. No elevated access needed for the hosted runs; traceroute and HTTP-level headers are fine.
- MSA + SOC2 artifacts: attaching standard MSA pointer and a redwood SOC2 summary link. If procurement wants the full SOC2 report we'll route via NDA/secure transfer.

Operational plan (high-level):
1) Monday EOD: Redwood shares runbook + k6 profile + test sheet (we will attach links).
2) Tue 06:30–09:30 PT: Hosted A/B sweeps (three test types). We'll do warmup + two measurement windows per test type.
3) Tue 10:00 PT: Immediate recap call to review preliminary numbers; deeper analysis by Wed EOD.

Acceptance criteria to flag as "win" for Redwood: consistent median p95 improvement over StratusAI >= 20% for seq <=128 AND tokens/sec at least 10% higher on summarization workload at the same cost bucket. We will surface cost-normalized numbers in the post-run.

Marissa / Jordan: please confirm you can deliver the run artifacts by EOD Mon. Tessa — can you be on-call for the Tuesday recap?

Thanks,
Rishi

--
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-mini-runbook.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2029 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: latency & throughput plan from today's discovery

All set on our side — I've uploaded the test matrix (horizon-test-matrix-v1.xlsx) and the k6 profiles to the shared sheet and granted Samira view access. Short checklist: 
- Hosted sandbox prepped with gpt-redwood-3b-quant and StratusAI competitor endpoint stubbed for measurement.
- k6 workload and token-encoder scripts are in the Sheet links (see tab "scripts").
- Exporter tagging: route=redwood-hosted, competitor=stratusai, run=HZN-2029-045. Prometheus + Grafana dashboards will be live for the Tue run; sharing link in the sheet.

I'll be on the Tue morning window and will own run orchestration. Jordan, pass me the cost-normalization script; Tessa, please standby for the 10:00 recap.

Marissa
Solutions Eng, Redwood Inference

Attachment references: horizon-test-matrix-v1.xlsx, redwood-mini-runbook.pdf
